translations.web: I, Yahweh, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day.
translations.bsb: I, the LORD, am its keeper; I water it continually. I guard it night and day so no one can disturb it;
translations.kjv: I the LORD do keep it; I will water it every moment: lest any hurt it, I will keep it night and day.
translations.asv: I Jehovah am its keeper; I will water it every moment: lest any hurt it, I will keep it night and day.
